name: ugrep
description: Universal grep with PCRE2/POSIX regex, archive search, fuzzy matching, multiline, and indexed acceleration

ugrep.description: Universal grep — POSIX/PCRE2 regex, multiline, recursive, archive (.zip/.tar/.gz/.bz2/.xz/.lz4/.zst/.7z) search, fuzzy matching, hex dump, and index acceleration
ugrep.usage:
ugrep -r 'TODO|FIXME' --include='*.lua' src/ # Recursive typed search
ugrep -P --multiline 'function\s+\w+.*?end' --include='*.lua' # Multiline PCRE2
ugrep -z 'pattern' archive.zip dir.tar.gz # Search inside archives
ugrep --fuzzy=2 'compleet' src/ # Approximate match (edit distance 2)
ugrep --index 'pattern' . # Use ugrep-indexer index for speed
ugrep -wcl 'Anomaly' gamedata/configs/ # Whole-word, count, files-with-matches
ugrep -X --hexdump 'DEADBEEF' binary.bin # Hex dump matches
ugrep --json 'pattern' src/ # JSON output for tooling

ug.description: Interactive ugrep variant with --smart-case, --pretty, built-in pager, and TUI query mode (-Q)
ug.usage:
ug 'pattern' src/ # Smart-case, pretty grouped output by default
ug -Q # Interactive TUI search session
ug -Q --include='*.script' gamedata/scripts/ # TUI scoped to .script files
ug --hexdump 'pattern' binary.dat # Hex dump in pretty mode
ug -P 'fn\s+\w+' src/ # PCRE2 with smart-case

ugrep-indexer.description: Pre-builds .ugrep index files in a directory tree to accelerate ugrep --index searches over large repos
ugrep-indexer.usage:
ugrep-indexer . # Build index for current directory tree
ugrep-indexer -f . # Force rebuild of all index files
ugrep-indexer -X . # Delete all .ugrep index files
ugrep-indexer -I '*.bin' . # Skip binary patterns when indexing
ugrep-indexer -q . # Quiet mode for scripts
